intro: Honduras is mountainous, with Caribbean islands, cloud forests and the wild Mosquitia.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Bay Islands, such as Roatán, sit on the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef, the second-largest reef in the world. La Mosquitia in the east is a huge wilderness of rainforest and rivers.

chapters.title: Hurricanes
text: Hurricanes from the Caribbean can cause floods and landslides.

keyTerms.meaning: A long coral reef parallel to a coast.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Honduras' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
